newsitem.title: MOROCCO: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Morocco economic weeklies - July 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Morocco's economic press. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Director of phosphates company OCP says the firm will be submitted to international auditing in two years to enable the real performance of the business to be measured.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj rebukes commercial banks for not lowering interest rates. He was speaking during a meeting of the National Council of Money and Saving.
- Road accidents fell seven percent in 1996 with 2,807 killed and 57,285 injured compared with the year before.
- Producers of canned fish say fish stocks are dwindling at an alarming rate.

- Morocco's fuel distributors say they are willing to invest five billion dirhams ($515.4 million) to upgrade the sector over five years and create 5,000 jobs provided the government promises to adjust margins on wholesale petrol.
